acceptance_criteria.criterion: Creating a new workspace generates its .code-workspace file inside the project subdirectory (no caller changes needed — path propagates through wsFilePath()).
Deleting a workspace removes the file from the project subdirectory.
migrateWorkspaceFiles is idempotent — running it when files are already in-place produces no errors and no duplicate files.
migrateWorkspaceFiles leaves unrecognized .code-workspace files (not matching any known slug) untouched.
On server startup, existing flat-layout workspace files are migrated to the nested layout.
api.config.polling.get() returns a promise that resolves with the polling config object from the server.
api.config.polling.set(60) sends a PUT request with { seconds: 60 } and returns the server response.
The Settings view (#/settings) displays a "Repositories Refresh Delay" section below the Git Credentials section.
On page load, the number input is populated with the current server-side value (e.g. 30).
Entering a valid value (>= 10) and clicking "Save" persists the value and shows a success toast.
Entering an invalid value (< 10) shows an error and does not submit to the server.
The section follows the existing settings view layout pattern (heading → description → interactive content).
